column1: # Router eval, dev split (TODO-2): the lightest tier that can do each request well, and the skill it needs.
# BASE: no tools or one simple read, short answers. PRO: writes, dates, several steps, summaries, medium writing.
# CLOUD: long-form writing or deep analysis. Made-up people only. Written 2026-09-29, before the router was run on it.
